title: Animated Diamond Totems
description: This Resource Pack Makes The Totems Eyes Look Like Diamonds And Adds A Blinking Animation
body:
A simple Minecraft resource pack that gives the Totem of Undying diamond eyes and a smooth blinking animation.

Features:

Animated blinking eyes
Diamond-style blue eyes
Smooth loop animation
Vanilla-style design

Works great for survival and PvP while keeping the classic Minecraft look.

Compatible with Minecraft Java 1.21.11+.
